reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared worstCaseAmount/expectedScheduleAmount helpers and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the change simplifies the helpers (Math.min, single subtraction).

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/rules.ts where the tree defines it and all server consumers import it.

scope.why: Only the two helper bodies, their comments and the matching tests change.

maintainability.why: Small, clearly documented helpers; the pre-existing midpoint logic in shared/schedules.ts (getScheduledAmount, preview) remains a separate rule a maintainer must be aware of.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server consumers (api-models, forecast, schedules/app, schedule-template) go through expectedScheduleAmount

one_place.where: worstCaseAmount / expectedScheduleAmount in shared/rules.ts, used by api-models, forecast-schedules, schedules/app and schedule-template; the midpoint computations in shared/schedules.ts are a pre-existing separate rule not touched here
